WP(C).No. 13812 of 2017 (B)
----------------------------
 APPENDIX PETITIONER'S EXHIBITS:
EXT.P1: FOOD BUSINESS OPERATOR LICENSE DATED 05.05.2016 ISSUED TO  THE PETITIONER.
EXT.P2: NOTICE NO.H1.4013/2016 DATED 17.3.2017 ISSUED BY THE 3RD  RESPONDENT EXT.P3: REPLY OF THE PETITIONER DATED 18.3.2017

EXT.P4: ORDER NO.K1-15358/2017 DATED 30.3.2017 EXT.P5: TRUE COPIES OF THE PHOTOGRAPHS SHOWING THE DISTRIBUTION  OF THE WATER BY THE 3RD RESPONDENT EXT.P6: REPRESENTATION DATED 06.04.2017 OF THE PETITIONER TO THE 2ND

RESPONDENT EXT.P7: ACKNOWLEDGMENT RECEIPT ISSUED BY THE 2ND RESPONDENT RESPONDENTS EXHIBITS: NIL  //TRUE COPY//
 P.A. TO JUDGE dlk  SHAJI P. CHALY, J.
Petitioner is engaged in business of supply of drinking water.
The water is extracted by the petitioner from the well in his property.

The quality test of the water samples from the well of the petitioner is done by the Kerala Water Authority and had issued a Report on Analysis of drinking water stating that the tested parameters are within the limits.

However, while so, the 2nd respondent issued a notice acquiring the well of the petitioner invoking the provisions of Sec.26(2)
and other provisions under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.
According to the petitioner, the 3rd respondent is permitted to continue the distribution of water without requiring compliance of any safety standards and hygiene measures.

Thereupon, petitioner has submitted Ext.P6 before the 2nd respondent, which is pending consideration.
2. Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader and the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the 3rd respondent, there will be a direction to the 2nd respondent to take on board Ext.P6 and consider the same in accordance with law, after providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner or any interested or affected persons, within a month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
The writ petition is disposed of accordingly.

Sd/-
SHAJI P. CHALY JUDGE St/-
